title: Constructing √2 on a Number Line
body: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 700"><style>.title{font-family:serif;font-size:50px;fill:#d4af37;text-anchor:middle}.text{font-family:serif;font-size:34px;fill:white;text-anchor:middle}.line{stroke:#d4af37;stroke-width:5}.guide{stroke:#60a5fa;stroke-width:4;stroke-dasharray:10 10}.point{fill:#d4af37}</style><rect x="50" y="50" width="1100" height="600" rx="35" fill="#101827" fill-opacity=".85" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="3"/><text x="600" y="120" class="title">Constructing √2 on a Number Line</text><rect x="150" y="220" width="220" height="220" fill="#162943" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="4"/><line x1="150" y1="440" x2="370" y2="220" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="6"/><text x="260" y="500" class="text">1 × 1 Square</text><text x="270" y="320" class="text" fill="#60a5fa">√2</text><text x="260" y="580" class="text">Diagonal = √2</text><line x1="600" y1="420" x2="1050" y2="420" class="line"/><line x1="600" y1="390" x2="600" y2="450" class="line"/><line x1="750" y1="390" x2="750" y2="450" class="line"/><line x1="900" y1="390" x2="900" y2="450" class="line"/><line x1="1000" y1="390" x2="1000" y2="450" class="line"/><text x="600" y="500" class="text">0</text><text x="750" y="500" class="text">1</text><text x="900" y="500" class="text">2</text><circle cx="812" cy="420" r="12" class="point"/><line x1="812" y1="420" x2="812" y2="300" class="guide"/><text x="812" y="260" class="text">√2</text><text x="812" y="560" class="text">≈ 1.414</text></svg>
